
```{r}
#| label: setup-packages
#| code-summary: "Load packages"
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```


```{r}

scopus_raw =
readr::read_csv(
  "poster/data/scopus.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

names(scopus_raw)
```


```{r}
#| label: filter-data
#| code-summary: "Stratify data"

scopus =
scopus_raw |>
  filter(
    !is.na(source_title),
    !is.na(year),
    year >= 2021,
    year <= 2025
  ) |>
  mutate(
    journal = stringr::str_squish(source_title),
    year = as.integer(year)
  )

# Considering that Vegetation Ecology and Diversity only publishes in 2025, we will delete it from the analyses.
# Staying with the other nine journals.

core_journals = c(
  "Journal of Vegetation Science",
  "Applied Vegetation Science",
  "Vegetation Classification and Survey",
  "Journal of Ecology",
  "Journal of Plant Ecology",
  "Plant Ecology",
  "Plant Biosystems",
  "Folia Geobotanica",
  "Ecology and Evolution"
)

scopus_core = 
scopus |>
  filter(journal %in% core_journals)

scopus_core |>
  count(journal, sort = TRUE)

nrow(scopus_core)


scopus_core |>
  count(journal, year) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  arrange(journal)
# Checking number of articles per journal and year
```



```{r}
#| label: organize-data
#| code-summary: "Organize data for screening"

set.seed(20260920)

screening_sample =
 scopus_core |>
  group_by(journal, year) |>
  mutate(
    stratum_population = n()
  ) |>
  group_modify(
    ~ slice_sample(.x, n = min(5, nrow(.x)))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    stratum_sample = pmin(5L, stratum_population),
    inclusion_probability = stratum_sample / stratum_population,
    sampling_weight = stratum_population / stratum_sample,
    sampling_stratum = paste(journal, year, sep = "_"),
    screening_decision = NA_character_,
    exclusion_reason = NA_character_,
    notes = NA_character_
  ) |>
  arrange(journal, year, title)

```


```{r}
#| label: check-data
nrow(screening_sample) 

screening_sample |>
  count(journal, year) |>
  filter(n > 5)

screening_sample |>
  count(journal, sort = TRUE)

screening_sample |>
  distinct(journal, year) |>
  nrow()
```

We included nine pre-specified international journals with continuous Scopus coverage from 2021 to 2025. Records were stratified by publication outlet and year. Within each journal–year stratum, we randomly selected up to five records; all records were retained from strata containing fewer than five records. This design yielded a balanced screening sample while preserving representation across journals and years.


```{r}
screening_sheet =
screening_sample |>
  arrange(journal, year, title)
```


```{r}
readr::write_csv(
  screening_sheet,
  "C:/VSCode/JuMiGa/poster/data/screening.csv",
  na = ""
)

saveRDS(
  screening_sheet,

)
```
